tagline: Guess the word before the gallows fills. Race a friend, or share the rope.
description:
A word is hiding. Pick a letter. Right ones fill in; six wrong ones and the drawing is finished. The words are programming languages — Python, Ruby, Java, and a dozen more.

On your own it is that game, on this device. Close it and come back: a game in progress is still there.

Send the invite and two of you get the same word. Race, and the first to finish it wins — each of you has your own drawing, and you never see the other person's letters, only how many wrong guesses they have used. Or share the gallows: every letter anyone tries is on the same rope, so you sink or swim together.

An unofficial port of Vanilla Javascript Hangman Game by simonjsuh.
